name: zvideo_dd_enum_directdraw_device_callback
description: zVideo_dd::EnumDirectDrawDeviceCallback records usable DirectDraw devices, queries caps and memory through IDirectDraw2, enumerates D3D devices for the record, and keeps enumeration running unless capacity or caps setup fails.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /MD /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?EnumDirectDrawDeviceCallback@zVideo_dd@@YGHPAU_GUID@@PAD1PAX@Z passes with zero unmasked mismatches after 120 relocation-masked bytes and 5 trimmed VC NOP bytes.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a93d0 validates the DirectDrawEnumerateA callback ABI, logging with g_zVideo_DirectDrawEnumOrdinal, capacity stop at four accepted devices, zeroing the selected g_zVideo_HwApiDeviceTable row, GUID pointer/storage handling, 0x20/0x60 driver name and description copies, g_zVideo_pSelectedHwApiDeviceRecord assignment, CreateDirectDraw2ForSelectedDevice call, DDCAPS HAL/HEL zeroing and dwSize initialization, IDirectDraw2::GetCaps failure ReportError at zvid_dd.c line 0x739 and return 0, AGP dwCaps bit 0x200 tagging with [AGP], video-memory and texture-memory GetAvailableVidMem calls with DDSCAPS_VIDEOMEMORY and DDSCAPS_TEXTURE, zeroing memory fields on query failure, EnumerateDirect3DDevicesForRecord call, accepted DirectDraw count increment only when that call succeeds, TeardownVideoSubsystem, and return 1 to continue enumeration.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a93d0 has no warning tags. Direct callees CreateDirectDraw2ForSelectedDevice, ReportError, EnumerateDirect3DDevicesForRecord, and TeardownVideoSubsystem are tier C or better; remaining calls are DirectDraw provider and CRT provider calls.

The native smoke patches only the direct internal callees and uses a fake IDirectDraw2 provider. It verifies the capacity stop, a successful AGP device row with copied GUID/name/description, caps input sizes, memory totals, EnumerateDirect3DDevicesForRecord handoff and accepted-count increment, a null-GUID row whose D3D enumeration rejects the device and does not increment the accepted count, GetAvailableVidMem failure zeroing memory fields, and the GetCaps failure path returning FALSE before memory queries, D3D enumeration, or teardown.
